mission: TRM-7M Training Pipeline - Local Model Fine-tuning for Recursive Reasoning

tasks.title: Create robust JSON extraction script
tasks.description: Implement scripts/extract_weird_jsonl.py with lenient JSON parsing (handles smart quotes, empty lines, weird numbering). Must extract all 659+ JSON objects from weirdly-numbered-json-contents.md.
acceptance_criteria: Script successfully parses messy JSON with brace-matching
Handles Unicode quote normalization (smart quotes → standard quotes)
Provides error recovery for malformed entries

tasks.title: Extract training data from source file
tasks.description: Execute extraction script on weirdly-numbered-json-contents.md, produce data/seed.jsonl with all 659 objects.
acceptance_criteria: No data loss from source file
Extraction report includes object count and error summary

tasks.title: Validate extraction quality
tasks.description: Create tests for extraction script: malformed JSON recovery, Unicode handling, empty line tolerance, correct object count.
acceptance_criteria: Test malformed JSON recovery (missing braces, extra commas)
Test empty line and comment handling
All tests pass with 100% extraction rate

phases.title: Heuristic Sampling for Maximum Information Gain

tasks.title: Implement complexity-based sampling algorithm
tasks.description: Create scripts/sample_for_labeling.py with complexity scoring (instruction length + keyword presence). Keywords: graph, dag, csp, sat, knapsack, schedule, invariant, recurs, prove, edge, dependency, constraint, shortest, optimal, induct, contradiction.
acceptance_criteria: Complexity score function ranks by instruction length
Bonus points (50) for each complexity keyword present
Sample top N most complex examples for labeling

tasks.title: Generate 200-sample subset for labeling
tasks.description: Execute sampling script to create data/sample_200.jsonl with highest-complexity examples from seed.jsonl.
acceptance_criteria: Objects sorted by complexity score (highest first)
All samples have valid JSON structure

tasks.title: Validate sampling quality and diversity
tasks.description: Create tests for sampling script: complexity scoring correctness, keyword detection, deterministic output, sample diversity.
acceptance_criteria: Test sample diversity (not all same type)

tasks.title: Design TRM routing decision prompt template
tasks.description: Create optimal prompt template for GPT-5 CODEX to decide when TRM-7M should be called. Binary classification: 1 (call TRM) for deep logical/recursive/constraint tasks, 0 (no TRM) for simple I/O/formatting.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt clearly defines TRM use cases (graphs, SAT, CSP, inductive proofs, edge-case inference)
Prompt includes decision criteria (complexity, reasoning depth)
Prompt handles ambiguous cases (prefer 1 only with explicit reasoning request)
Prompt template accepts input object with instruction/prompt/input fields

tasks.title: Implement batch auto-labeling script
tasks.description: Create scripts/auto_label_batch.py to call GPT-5 CODEX on data/sample_200.jsonl, produce data/auto_200.jsonl with labels. Uses OpenAI batch API for cost efficiency.
acceptance_criteria: Batch API integration (not streaming, for cost control)
Robust error handling (retry on timeout, skip malformed)
Output format: {id, instruction, input, label, source='auto', confidence, timestamp}

tasks.title: Execute auto-labeling on 200-sample
tasks.description: Run auto-labeler on data/sample_200.jsonl, produce data/auto_200.jsonl with GPT-5 CODEX labels.
acceptance_criteria: Confidence scores included (if available from API)
Labeling report: count of 0s vs 1s, cost, time

tasks.title: Validate auto-labeling correctness
tasks.description: Create tests for auto-labeler: batch API usage, error handling, output format, cost calculation.

tasks.title: Design one-page labeling rubric
tasks.description: Create clear, concise rubric for human labelers: 1 (YES) for graph/DAG/SAT/CSP/proof/edge-case tasks, 0 (NO) for single-file/formatting/simple I/O, S (skip) for incomplete context. Include 10 gold examples for calibration.
acceptance_criteria: Rubric fits on one page (markdown format)
Fatigue prevention: recommend 50-100 labels per session
Optional notes field for edge cases

tasks.title: Build interactive labeling CLI tool
tasks.description: Create scripts/manual_label_cli.py: interactive terminal UI to review/correct auto-labels from data/auto_200.jsonl, output to data/labeled_200.jsonl.
acceptance_criteria: Display instruction + auto-label, ask for confirmation/correction
Accept inputs: Y (confirm), N (flip label), S (skip), Q (quit with progress save)
Final output: data/labeled_200.jsonl with reviewed_by, review_time, notes fields

tasks.title: Validate review CLI functionality
tasks.description: Create tests for review CLI: navigation, auto-save, progress tracking, output format.

tasks.title: Merge auto + human labels into final dataset
tasks.description: Create scripts/merge_labels.py: combine data/auto_200.jsonl (auto-labels) + data/labeled_200.jsonl (human-reviewed) → learning/trm_labels.jsonl. Human labels override auto-labels.
acceptance_criteria: Output format: {id, instruction, input, label, source (human|auto), reviewed_by, review_time, notes, confidence}
Duplicate detection (same instruction appears multiple times)
Quality report: human vs auto agreement rate, label distribution

tasks.title: Execute merge to produce final dataset
tasks.description: Run merge script to create learning/trm_labels.jsonl with 200+ labeled examples.
acceptance_criteria: Source field indicates human or auto

tasks.title: Implement dataset quality validator
tasks.description: Create scripts/validate_training_data.py: check learning/trm_labels.jsonl for balance (not >90% one class), diversity (keyword coverage), completeness (all required fields).
acceptance_criteria: Check label balance (30-70% for each class)
Check schema completeness (id, instruction, input, label, source)
Check for data leakage (no test data in training)

tasks.title: Validate quality validator correctness
tasks.description: Create tests for quality validator: balance checking, diversity scoring, schema validation.
acceptance_criteria: Test balance detection (imbalanced dataset triggers warning)

tasks.title: Design training configuration for Qwen3-Coder/GPT-OSS
tasks.description: Create optimal training config for local fine-tuning: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) for parameter efficiency, binary classification head, learning rate schedule, batch size, epochs.
acceptance_criteria: LoRA rank=8, alpha=16 for memory efficiency
Learning rate: 2e-4 with warmup (10% of steps)
Batch size: 4 (fits in 48GB M4 Pro memory)

tasks.title: Implement local model fine-tuning script
tasks.description: Create scripts/train_router.py using Hugging Face Transformers + PEFT (Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning). Supports qwen3coder-30b and gpt-oss-20b, outputs LoRA adapter to models/trm_router_lora/.
acceptance_criteria: Load base model (qwen3coder-30b or gpt-oss-20b) in 8-bit quantization
Apply LoRA adapter to attention layers
Track metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, F1 on validation set
Training completes in <2 hours on M4 Pro 48GB

tasks.title: Build TRM router inference wrapper
tasks.description: Create tools/trm_router.py: lightweight wrapper to load LoRA adapter + base model, classify tasks (0 or 1), integrate with Agency orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: Load base model + LoRA adapter from models/trm_router_lora/

tasks.title: Validate training script correctness
tasks.description: Create tests for training script: LoRA initialization, data loading, metric tracking, checkpoint saving.

tasks.title: Implement shadow mode for parallel routing
tasks.description: Create tools/orchestrator/shadow_router.py: run TRM router in parallel with production routing (Leap 3 model router), log discrepancies for retraining without impacting production.
acceptance_criteria: Run both routers (production + TRM) on every task
Production router controls actual execution (no impact)
Track metrics: agreement rate, TRM precision/recall, latency difference
Weekly summary report for retraining decisions

tasks.title: Build telemetry dashboard for shadow mode
tasks.description: Create scripts/shadow_mode_dashboard.py: visualize shadow mode metrics (agreement rate over time, confusion matrix, cost impact if TRM were live).
acceptance_criteria: Plot agreement rate over time (7-day rolling window)
Calculate hypothetical cost savings if TRM were live

tasks.title: Implement automated retraining trigger
tasks.description: Create scripts/auto_retrain.py: monitor shadow mode metrics, trigger retraining if agreement rate drops below threshold (e.g., 85%), collect new labeled examples from discrepancies.
acceptance_criteria: Trigger retraining if rate <85% for 2 consecutive weeks
Collect discrepancies as new training data (human review required)

tasks.title: Validate shadow mode correctness
tasks.description: Create tests for shadow mode: parallel routing, discrepancy logging, production non-impact.
acceptance_criteria: Test both routers execute in parallel
Test production router controls actual execution

tasks.title: Integrate TRM router into model policy
tasks.description: Update shared/model_policy.py to use TRM router for tier classification. If TRM label=1 (complex reasoning), route to TRM-7M, else use existing Leap 3 router (P1/P2/P3).
acceptance_criteria: Query TRM router before Leap 3 router
If TRM label=1, route to TRM-7M for recursive reasoning
If TRM label=0, fallback to Leap 3 router (gpt-5/gpt-4o/local)
Track TRM routing decisions in telemetry

tasks.title: Build TRM-7M agent wrapper
tasks.description: Create coding_agent/trm_agent.py: wrapper for TRM-7M recursive reasoning model, handles grid-based input/output, integrates with Agency context.
acceptance_criteria: Load TRM-7M model (7M params, local inference)
Accept task description → convert to grid format

tasks.title: Add TRM validation gates to /primeA workflow
tasks.description: Update .claude/commands/primea.md to include TRM-7M validation checkpoints (STEP 3.1, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3) as documented in Leap 8 spec.
acceptance_criteria: All checkpoints integrated into execution protocol

tasks.title: Validate end-to-end TRM integration
tasks.description: Create integration tests: TRM router → TRM-7M agent → validation gates in /primeA workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Test TRM router classification accuracy on known examples
Test TRM-7M agent inference on reasoning tasks
Test validation gates trigger correctly (DAG, types, edge cases, lint)

tasks.title: Generate ADR-034 for TRM Training Pipeline
tasks.description: Create docs/adr/ADR-034-trm-training-pipeline.md documenting the entire training workflow, design decisions, cost analysis, and integration with Agency.
acceptance_criteria: Context: TRM-7M recursive reasoning, local model fine-tuning goal
Decision: LoRA fine-tuning on 659 extracted examples, shadow mode deployment
Consequences: 40-60% churn reduction, $0 inference cost, <1s latency
Alternatives Considered: Cloud API vs local, full fine-tuning vs LoRA
Constitutional Alignment: Article IV (learning), Article I (complete context)

tasks.title: Write TRM training pipeline user guide
tasks.description: Create docs/TRM_TRAINING_GUIDE.md: step-by-step guide for users to train their own TRM router model using the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Prerequisites: Python 3.11+, 48GB RAM, Hugging Face account
Step-by-step execution: extraction → sampling → labeling → training → deployment
Troubleshooting: common errors, memory issues, labeling quality tips
Cost estimation: OpenAI API costs for auto-labeling
Expected results: 85%+ agreement rate in shadow mode

tasks.title: Update main README with TRM training section
tasks.description: Add TRM Training Pipeline section to CLAUDE.md, link to ADR-034 and user guide.
acceptance_criteria: Quick start example (5 commands from extraction to deployment)

checkpoints.prompt: Review auto-labeled data quality before proceeding to human review phase. Check label distribution (expect 30-70% balance), sample 10 examples for correctness.
Validate final training dataset quality. Review quality report: balance, diversity, agreement rate. Approve before expensive training phase.
Review shadow mode telemetry after 1 week. Check agreement rate, confusion matrix, cost impact. Decide: promote to production or retrain.
